items.problem: UWP Application suspend/resume events (App.Current.Suspending / .Resuming) are unmigrated and cause 4x CS1061, failing the whole build.
items.evidence: migration-score.json winui_build_errors: "CS1061: 'Application' does not contain a definition for 'Suspending' ... 'Resuming'"; final source EventHandlerForDevice.cs:398/400/406/409 and Scenario1_ConnectDisconnect.xaml.cs:215/217/223/225 still contain App.Current.Suspending += / .Resuming +=.
items.skill_search: grepped winui-uwp-migration for 'Suspend|Resum|EnteredBackground|LeavingBackground|SuspendingEventHandler' -> zero matches in SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, and unsupported-api-inventory.json
items.root_cause: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application does not expose Suspending/Resuming (or EnteredBackground/LeavingBackground); desktop WinUI 3 apps aren't PLM-suspended. The skill's #lifecycle section only covers OnLaunched/activation, and the inventory has no pattern for the suspend/resume surface, so no TODO was injected and the agent left the UWP code verbatim.
items.proposed_fix: 1) Add an 'adaptable' entry to scripts/unsupported-api-inventory.json matching the suspend/resume event surface, routed to anchor 'lifecycle', so Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 injects a TODO at each site. 2) Extend MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md #lifecycle with a subsection: these events are removed; move teardown to the main Window.Closed event and drop the resume path (or no-op it).
items.generalizes: The EventHandlerForDevice suspend/resume helper is copy-pasted across the entire Windows-universal-samples device-access family (SerialPort, USB, HID, Bluetooth, PointOfService), and Application.Suspending/Resuming/EnteredBackground/LeavingBackground appear in countless UWP apps. Any of them hits the identical CS1061 today.
